archive.restore_instruction: Verify every archive against SHA256SUMS.txt, then extract all part-*.tar.gz archives into an empty repository root. Compare restored paths and sizes with source_manifest.tsv before using any data.

reproduction_tools.new_archive_policy: Use a new tag for every replacement archive; do not silently overwrite a published asset.

historical_release_notes: The published 2026-08-24 archive predates the sanitized release builder and may contain machine-specific metadata and runtime logs.
New public archives must be generated with scripts/release/build_public_data_release.ps1 and verified with scripts/release/verify_public_release.py.
The local progress log is not part of the public Git worktree or new release archives.
warning: The archive is public, but it must not be described as locally restored or fully verified until all parts have been downloaded, checked against SHA256SUMS.txt, and extracted successfully.
